description_sq:
Ofrojme Apartament 1+1 per shitje tek Rruga Sali Butka, ne nje objekt te vitit 2015, te mire administruar e te mirembajtur.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e kater me orientim lindje, organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje me ambjent gatimi, dhome gjumi, tualet, korridor dhe ballkon.
description_en: We offer 1+1 Apartment for sale on Sali Butka Street, in a building built in 2015, well managed and well maintained. The apartment is located on the fourth floor facing east, it is organized in a living room with a kitchen area, a bedroom, a toilet, a corridor and a balcony.
